decisions.reason: Although the firm has strong in-house R&D and university links that support learning, this superfood drink mix is less central to its industrial waste-to-value knowledge base and was only briefly mentioned on the website, so it is somewhat more at risk than the other products.

These modular waste-to-energy plant extensions fit the firm's established technological and engineering capabilities closely, and its strong absorptive capacity makes continued refinement and commercialization likely.
The waste-oil-to-energy plant builds directly on the firm's core knowledge and was presented on its own page, indicating stronger commitment and a low likelihood of withdrawal.

The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant is still close to the firm's existing waste-conversion expertise and benefits from its R&D base, though being only close rather than fully established makes it slightly more uncertain than the core products.
